name: Gästehaus Franz
beschreibung: Gästehaus Franz in Tyrol is a traditional inn featuring cozy guest rooms. It boasts a quiet yet central village location, providing immediate access to scenic hiking trails. The rooms are simply and functionally furnished, each featuring a private balcony with picturesque panoramic views. The rustic parlor is warmly appreciated by vacationers and locals alike. The kitchen serves delicious regional specialties and beloved Tyrolean classics. The surrounding alpine landscape provides the perfect setting for outdoor pursuits throughout the year. The guesthouse also offers secure storage facilities for bicycles and ski gear.
